expected.rationale: The integration passage directly describes the common weave.init project parameter and its two destination forms. This is a supported shared API statement, not an inference that unrelated Verdict-specific behavior applies to every application. Rejecting solely because S3 is an integration page is a false positive.

claims.text: weave.init() authenticates with W&B and configures the OTel exporter that sends agent spans to the Agents view.
claims.answer_quote: `weave.init()` authenticates with Weights & Biases and configures the OpenTelemetry exporter that sends agent spans to the Agents view [S1]

claims.text: It initializes the project destination so SDK routes spans to the correct place.
claims.answer_quote: It initializes the project destination so the SDK routes spans to the correct place [S4].
claims.scope_reason: S4 says init registers team and project so SDK routes spans to correct location.

claims.text: Pass "my-team/my-project" with team as CoreWeave Forge team and project as W&B project name.
claims.answer_quote: Pass `"my-team/my-project"`, replacing `my-team` with your CoreWeave Forge team and `my-project` with your Weights & Biases project name [S2][S4]

claims.text: Call it before start_conversation() and start_turn(); helpers silently do nothing if init is absent.
claims.answer_quote: Call it before the agent tracing helpers such as `start_conversation()` and `start_turn()`; those helpers silently do nothing if initialization is absent [S4].

claims.text: Verdict guide documents project argument: team-name/project-name selects a team/project, project-name logs to default team or entity.
claims.answer_quote: `team-name/project-name` selects a particular team/project, while `project-name` logs to the default team or entity [S3]
claims.scope_reason: Attributed to the Verdict guide's documentation of weave.init(project=...), which is the same Python function.

claims.text: Use the full form when you want to name the destination explicitly.
claims.answer_quote: Use the full form above when you want to name the destination explicitly [S2][S3].
